text:
SELECT title, acquisition_date
FROM artworks
WHERE medium = 'oil on canvas'
  AND date(REPLACE(acquisition_date, '/', '-')) < '1970-01-01';

SELECT artwork_id, title, acquisition_cost
FROM artworks
WHERE acquisition_cost IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY acquisition_cost DESC
LIMIT 5;
SELECT name, area_sqm FROM galleries WHERE floor = 2 ORDER BY area_sqm DESC;
SELECT exhibition_id, title FROM exhibitions WHERE ticket_price IS NULL;

SELECT DISTINCT a.full_name, a.nationality
FROM artists a
JOIN artworks aw ON a.artist_id = aw.artist_id
WHERE a.death_year IS NULL
  AND a.nationality IS NOT NULL
  AND a.nationality != '';

SELECT artwork_id, title, condition_rating
FROM artworks
WHERE condition_rating <= 2
ORDER BY condition_rating ASC;

SELECT a.title, ar.full_name
FROM artworks a
JOIN artists ar ON a.artist_id = ar.artist_id
WHERE ar.nationality = 'American';

SELECT a.title AS artwork_title, g.name AS gallery_name
FROM artworks a
JOIN galleries g ON a.gallery_id = g.gallery_id
WHERE g.floor = 3;

SELECT a.title, ar.full_name
FROM artworks a
JOIN artists ar ON a.artist_id = ar.artist_id
WHERE a.gallery_id IS NULL;

SELECT a.title, ea.insured_value
FROM artworks a
JOIN exhibition_artworks ea ON a.artwork_id = ea.artwork_id
JOIN exhibitions e ON ea.exhibition_id = e.exhibition_id
WHERE e.title = 'Modern Masters';

SELECT e.title AS exhibition_title, g.name AS gallery_name
FROM exhibitions e
JOIN galleries g ON e.gallery_id = g.gallery_id
WHERE e.ticket_price > 15;

SELECT e.exhibition_id, e.title
FROM exhibitions e
LEFT JOIN exhibition_artworks ea ON e.exhibition_id = ea.exhibition_id
WHERE ea.exhibition_id IS NULL;

SELECT a.nationality, SUM(aw.acquisition_cost) AS total_acquisition_cost
FROM artworks aw
JOIN artists a ON aw.artist_id = a.artist_id
WHERE a.nationality IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY a.nationality;

SELECT g.floor, AVG(e.ticket_price) AS average_ticket_price
FROM exhibitions e
JOIN galleries g ON e.gallery_id = g.gallery_id
GROUP BY g.floor;

SELECT strftime('%Y', REPLACE(start_date, '/', '-')) AS year, COUNT(*) AS exhibition_count
FROM exhibitions
GROUP BY year
ORDER BY year;

SELECT a.full_name, COUNT(aw.artwork_id) AS artwork_count
FROM artists a
JOIN artworks aw ON a.artist_id = aw.artist_id
GROUP BY a.artist_id, a.full_name
HAVING COUNT(aw.artwork_id) > 1
ORDER BY artwork_count DESC;

SELECT
    CASE
        WHEN creation_year < 1800 THEN 'before 1800'
        WHEN creation_year BETWEEN 1800 AND 1899 THEN '1800s'
        WHEN creation_year BETWEEN 1900 AND 1999 THEN '1900s'
        ELSE '2000s onward'
    END AS period,
    COUNT(*) AS piece_count
FROM artworks
WHERE creation_year IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY period
ORDER BY
    CASE period
        WHEN 'before 1800' THEN 1
        WHEN '1800s' THEN 2
        WHEN '1900s' THEN 3
        ELSE 4
    END;

SELECT e.title,
       CAST(julianday(e.end_date) - julianday(e.start_date) AS INTEGER) AS duration_days
FROM exhibitions e
WHERE e.end_date IS NOT NULL
  AND date(REPLACE(e.end_date, '/', '-')) < date('now')
ORDER BY duration_days DESC
LIMIT 5;
SELECT name, weight_kg FROM pets WHERE species = 'dog' AND weight_kg > 25 ORDER BY weight_kg DESC;
SELECT * FROM visits ORDER BY fee DESC LIMIT 5;
SELECT pet_id, name, species, breed, birth_date, weight_kg, microchip_id FROM pets WHERE microchip_id IS NULL OR microchip_id = '';

SELECT first_name, last_name, registered_date
FROM owners
WHERE city = 'Round Rock'
ORDER BY date(REPLACE(registered_date, '/', '-')) ASC;

SELECT full_name, specialty, hire_date FROM vets WHERE strftime('%Y', REPLACE(hire_date, '/', '-')) >= '2020' ORDER BY strftime('%Y', REPLACE(hire_date, '/', '-')) DESC, strftime('%m', REPLACE(hire_date, '/', '-')) DESC, strftime('%d', REPLACE(hire_date, '/', '-')) DESC;

SELECT visit_id, pet_id, vet_id, visit_date, reason, diagnosis, fee, follow_up_needed
FROM visits
WHERE follow_up_needed = 1
ORDER BY date(REPLACE(visit_date, '/', '-'));

SELECT
    v.visit_date,
    p.name AS pet_name,
    ve.full_name AS vet_name,
    v.reason
FROM visits v
JOIN pets p ON v.pet_id = p.pet_id
JOIN vets ve ON v.vet_id = ve.vet_id
WHERE date(REPLACE(v.visit_date, '/', '-')) >= date('2023-07-01')
  AND date(REPLACE(v.visit_date, '/', '-')) <= date('2023-12-31');

SELECT o.first_name, o.last_name, p.name
FROM owners o
JOIN pets p ON o.owner_id = p.owner_id
WHERE p.species = 'cat';

SELECT v.full_name AS vet_name, vi.visit_date
FROM visits vi
JOIN pets p ON vi.pet_id = p.pet_id
JOIN vets v ON vi.vet_id = v.vet_id
WHERE p.name = 'Bella'
ORDER BY vi.visit_date;

SELECT o.owner_id, o.first_name, o.last_name
FROM owners o
LEFT JOIN pets p ON o.owner_id = p.owner_id
WHERE p.pet_id IS NULL;

SELECT v.diagnosis, p.name
FROM visits v
JOIN pets p ON v.pet_id = p.pet_id
JOIN vets ve ON v.vet_id = ve.vet_id
WHERE ve.specialty = 'Surgery';
SELECT species, COUNT(*) AS pet_count FROM pets GROUP BY species;
SELECT city, COUNT(*) AS client_count FROM owners GROUP BY city;

SELECT v.vet_id, v.full_name, COUNT(vi.visit_id) AS visit_count, SUM(vi.fee) AS total_fees
FROM vets v
LEFT JOIN visits vi ON v.vet_id = vi.vet_id
GROUP BY v.vet_id, v.full_name
ORDER BY v.vet_id;
SELECT species, AVG(weight_kg) AS average_weight_kg FROM pets WHERE weight_kg IS NOT NULL GROUP BY species;

SELECT v.visit_id, v.pet_id, v.fee, p.name AS pet_name
FROM visits v
JOIN pets p ON v.pet_id = p.pet_id
WHERE v.fee > (SELECT AVG(fee) FROM visits);

SELECT o.owner_id, o.first_name, o.last_name, COUNT(v.visit_id) AS total_visits, SUM(v.fee) AS total_spent
FROM owners o
JOIN pets p ON o.owner_id = p.owner_id
JOIN visits v ON p.pet_id = v.pet_id
GROUP BY o.owner_id, o.first_name, o.last_name
HAVING COUNT(v.visit_id) >= 2;

WITH normalized AS (
    SELECT
        pet_id,
        CASE
            WHEN birth_date IS NULL OR TRIM(birth_date) = '' THEN NULL
            ELSE date(REPLACE(birth_date, '/', '-'))
        END AS birth_dt
    FROM pets
),
aged AS (
    SELECT
        pet_id,
        CASE
            WHEN birth_dt IS NULL THEN 'unknown'
            WHEN birth_dt > '2021-01-01' THEN 'young'
            WHEN birth_dt >= '2016-01-01' THEN 'adult'
            ELSE 'senior'
        END AS age_group
    FROM normalized
)
SELECT
    age_group,
    COUNT(*) AS pet_count
FROM aged
WHERE age_group <> 'unknown'
GROUP BY age_group
ORDER BY
    CASE age_group
        WHEN 'young' THEN 1
        WHEN 'adult' THEN 2
        WHEN 'senior' THEN 3
    END;

WITH normalized_visits AS (
    SELECT
        pet_id,
        date(REPLACE(visit_date, '/', '-')) AS visit_date
    FROM visits
),
pet_visit_stats AS (
    SELECT
        pet_id,
        COUNT(*) AS visit_count,
        MIN(visit_date) AS first_visit,
        MAX(visit_date) AS last_visit
    FROM normalized_visits
    GROUP BY pet_id
    HAVING COUNT(*) > 1
)
SELECT
    pet_id,
    visit_count,
    julianday(last_visit) - julianday(first_visit) AS days_between
FROM pet_visit_stats;
SELECT wine_name, bottle_price FROM wines WHERE bottle_price > 25 ORDER BY bottle_price DESC;

SELECT customer_id, business_name, customer_type, city, state, account_opened
FROM customers
ORDER BY date(REPLACE(account_opened, '/', '-')) DESC
LIMIT 3;
SELECT * FROM orders WHERE status = 'Pending';
SELECT customer_id, business_name FROM customers WHERE credit_limit IS NULL;
SELECT name FROM producers WHERE country = 'American' AND organic_certified = 1;

SELECT w.wine_name, p.name AS producer_name
FROM wines w
JOIN producers p ON w.producer_id = p.producer_id
WHERE p.country = 'France';

SELECT c.business_name, o.order_date
FROM customers c
JOIN orders o ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id
WHERE date(REPLACE(o.order_date, '/', '-')) >= date('2023-07-01')
ORDER BY o.order_date;

SELECT DISTINCT w.wine_name
FROM wines w
JOIN order_items oi ON w.wine_id = oi.wine_id
JOIN orders o ON oi.order_id = o.order_id
JOIN customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id
WHERE c.business_name = 'Harbor Wine & Spirits';

SELECT c.business_name, o.order_date
FROM customers c
JOIN orders o ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id
WHERE c.customer_type = 'Restaurant';

SELECT oi.quantity AS bottles_ordered, p.name AS producer_name
FROM order_items oi
JOIN wines w ON oi.wine_id = w.wine_id
JOIN producers p ON w.producer_id = p.producer_id
WHERE p.country = 'Italy';

SELECT c.customer_id, c.business_name
FROM customers c
LEFT JOIN orders o ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id
WHERE o.order_id IS NULL;
SELECT color, AVG(bottle_price) AS average_bottle_cost FROM wines GROUP BY color;

SELECT o.status, SUM(oi.quantity) AS total_bottles
FROM orders o
JOIN order_items oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
GROUP BY o.status;

SELECT p.country, COUNT(DISTINCT w.wine_id) AS wine_count
FROM wines w
JOIN producers p ON w.producer_id = p.producer_id
GROUP BY p.country
ORDER BY wine_count DESC;

WITH normalized_orders AS (
    SELECT
        o.order_id,
        o.customer_id,
        o.status
    FROM orders o
    WHERE o.status != 'Cancelled'
),
order_revenue AS (
    SELECT
        no.customer_id,
        SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (1 - COALESCE(oi.discount_pct, 0) / 100.0)) AS total_spent
    FROM normalized_orders no
    JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = no.order_id
    GROUP BY no.customer_id
)
SELECT
    c.customer_id,
    c.business_name,
    orv.total_spent
FROM order_revenue orv
JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id = orv.customer_id
WHERE orv.total_spent > 1000
ORDER BY orv.total_spent DESC;

SELECT o.order_id,
       o.order_date,
       o.ship_date,
       CAST(julianday(REPLACE(o.ship_date, '/', '-')) - julianday(REPLACE(o.order_date, '/', '-')) AS INTEGER) AS days_to_ship
FROM orders o
WHERE o.ship_date IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY days_to_ship DESC
LIMIT 5;

SELECT
    CASE
        WHEN credit_limit IS NULL THEN 'none set'
        WHEN credit_limit >= 30000 THEN 'high'
        WHEN credit_limit >= 10000 THEN 'medium'
        ELSE 'low'
    END AS credit_tier,
    COUNT(*) AS customer_count
FROM customers
GROUP BY credit_tier
ORDER BY
    CASE credit_tier
        WHEN 'high' THEN 1
        WHEN 'medium' THEN 2
        WHEN 'low' THEN 3
        WHEN 'none set' THEN 4
    END;
SELECT title, planned_start FROM productions WHERE status = 'pre-production' ORDER BY date(REPLACE(planned_start, '/', '-')) ASC;
SELECT title, budget_usd FROM productions ORDER BY budget_usd DESC LIMIT 5;

SELECT name, city, country, daily_rate
FROM locations
WHERE indoor = 1 AND country = 'USA'
ORDER BY daily_rate DESC;

SELECT full_name, role, department, day_rate
FROM crew_members
ORDER BY day_rate DESC
LIMIT 5;

SELECT p.title AS film, l.name AS venue, sd.shoot_date
FROM shoot_days sd
JOIN productions p ON sd.production_id = p.production_id
JOIN locations l ON sd.location_id = l.location_id
WHERE time(REPLACE(sd.call_time, '/', ':')) >= '18:00:00'
   OR time(REPLACE(sd.call_time, '/', ':')) < '06:00:00';

SELECT sd.shoot_id, sd.shoot_date, p.title
FROM shoot_days sd
JOIN productions p ON sd.production_id = p.production_id
JOIN locations l ON sd.location_id = l.location_id
WHERE l.city = 'Baltimore';

SELECT cm.full_name, sd.shoot_date
FROM crew_members cm
JOIN crew_assignments ca ON cm.crew_id = ca.crew_id
JOIN shoot_days sd ON ca.shoot_id = sd.shoot_id
JOIN productions p ON sd.production_id = p.production_id
WHERE p.title = 'Midnight Harbor'
ORDER BY sd.shoot_date, cm.full_name;
SELECT full_name FROM crew_members WHERE crew_id NOT IN (SELECT crew_id FROM crew_assignments);

SELECT l.city, l.country, sd.shoot_date
FROM productions p
JOIN shoot_days sd ON p.production_id = sd.production_id
JOIN locations l ON sd.location_id = l.location_id
WHERE p.title = 'Neon Drift'
ORDER BY sd.shoot_date;
SELECT sd.* FROM shoot_days sd JOIN productions p ON sd.production_id = p.production_id WHERE p.budget_usd > 20000000;

SELECT p.title, COUNT(s.shoot_id) AS scheduled_shoot_days
FROM productions p
LEFT JOIN shoot_days s ON p.production_id = s.production_id
GROUP BY p.production_id, p.title
ORDER BY p.title;
SELECT genre, COUNT(*) AS film_count, SUM(budget_usd) AS total_budget FROM productions GROUP BY genre;

SELECT p.title, COALESCE(SUM(s.weather_delay_hours), 0) AS total_weather_delay_hours
FROM productions p
LEFT JOIN shoot_days s ON p.production_id = s.production_id
GROUP BY p.production_id, p.title
ORDER BY p.title;

SELECT p.title
FROM productions p
JOIN shoot_days s ON p.production_id = s.production_id
GROUP BY p.production_id, p.title
HAVING SUM(COALESCE(s.weather_delay_hours, 0)) > 1.5;

SELECT
    shoot_date,
    scenes_planned,
    scenes_completed,
    ROUND(CAST(scenes_completed AS REAL) / scenes_planned * 100, 2) AS completion_percentage
FROM shoot_days
WHERE scenes_completed IS NOT NULL
  AND scenes_completed < scenes_planned
ORDER BY shoot_date;

SELECT title,
       CAST(julianday(REPLACE(planned_wrap, '/', '-')) - julianday(REPLACE(planned_start, '/', '-')) AS INTEGER) AS scheduled_days
FROM productions
WHERE planned_wrap IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY scheduled_days DESC
LIMIT 5;
SELECT tech_id, full_name, certification_level, hire_date, hourly_rate, home_base FROM technicians ORDER BY hourly_rate DESC LIMIT 5;

SELECT
    wo.work_order_id,
    wo.turbine_id,
    wo.tech_id,
    wo.order_type,
    wo.priority,
    wo.opened_date,
    wo.labor_hours,
    wo.parts_cost,
    wo.description
FROM work_orders wo
WHERE wo.completed_date IS NULL
ORDER BY date(REPLACE(wo.opened_date, '/', '-')) ASC;

SELECT farm_id, farm_name, state, commissioned_date, capacity_mw, operator
FROM wind_farms
WHERE state IN ('Texas', 'Wyoming')
ORDER BY capacity_mw DESC;

SELECT work_order_id, parts_cost
FROM work_orders
ORDER BY parts_cost DESC
LIMIT 3;

SELECT tech_id, full_name, certification_level, hire_date, hourly_rate, home_base
FROM technicians
WHERE strftime('%Y', REPLACE(hire_date, '/', '-')) >= '2019'
ORDER BY date(REPLACE(hire_date, '/', '-'));

SELECT wo.work_order_id, wo.priority, wf.farm_name
FROM work_orders wo
JOIN turbines t ON wo.turbine_id = t.turbine_id
JOIN wind_farms wf ON t.farm_id = wf.farm_id
WHERE wo.priority IN ('High', 'Critical');

SELECT DISTINCT t.tech_id, t.full_name, t.certification_level
FROM technicians t
JOIN work_orders wo ON t.tech_id = wo.tech_id
WHERE wo.priority = 'Emergency';

SELECT wo.work_order_id, t.turbine_tag, t.model, wo.order_type, wo.description, wo.opened_date, wo.completed_date
FROM work_orders wo
JOIN turbines t ON wo.turbine_id = t.turbine_id
WHERE t.manufacturer = 'Vestas';

SELECT wo.work_order_id, wo.turbine_id, wo.tech_id, wo.order_type, wo.priority, wo.opened_date, wo.completed_date, wo.labor_hours, wo.parts_cost, wo.description
FROM work_orders wo
JOIN turbines t ON wo.turbine_id = t.turbine_id
JOIN wind_farms wf ON t.farm_id = wf.farm_id
WHERE wf.state = 'Iowa';

SELECT 
    t.turbine_tag AS turbine,
    wf.farm_name AS farm,
    wo.priority,
    COALESCE(tech.full_name, 'Unassigned') AS handler
FROM work_orders wo
JOIN turbines t ON wo.turbine_id = t.turbine_id
JOIN wind_farms wf ON t.farm_id = wf.farm_id
LEFT JOIN technicians tech ON wo.tech_id = tech.tech_id
WHERE wo.completed_date IS NULL;

SELECT wf.farm_name, COALESCE(SUM(wo.parts_cost), 0) AS total_parts_cost
FROM wind_farms wf
JOIN turbines t ON t.farm_id = wf.farm_id
JOIN work_orders wo ON wo.turbine_id = t.turbine_id
GROUP BY wf.farm_id, wf.farm_name
ORDER BY total_parts_cost DESC;

SELECT priority, AVG(labor_hours) AS avg_labor_hours
FROM work_orders
WHERE labor_hours IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY priority;
SELECT certification_level, COUNT(*) AS technician_count, AVG(hourly_rate) AS average_hourly_pay FROM technicians GROUP BY certification_level;

SELECT wf.farm_name
FROM wind_farms wf
JOIN turbines t ON wf.farm_id = t.farm_id
JOIN work_orders wo ON t.turbine_id = wo.turbine_id
GROUP BY wf.farm_id, wf.farm_name
HAVING SUM(COALESCE(wo.parts_cost, 0)) > 10000;

WITH cleaned AS (
    SELECT
        work_order_id,
        order_type,
        priority,
        date(REPLACE(opened_date, '/', '-')) AS opened_dt,
        date(REPLACE(completed_date, '/', '-')) AS completed_dt
    FROM work_orders
    WHERE completed_date IS NOT NULL
      AND order_type = 'corrective'
      AND priority = 'emergency'
)
SELECT
    work_order_id,
    (julianday(completed_dt) - julianday(opened_dt)) AS days_to_complete,
    CASE
        WHEN (julianday(completed_dt) - julianday(opened_dt)) >= 7 THEN 'slow'
        ELSE 'normal'
    END AS speed_category
FROM cleaned;

SELECT t.turbine_id, t.turbine_tag, t.farm_id, COUNT(wo.work_order_id) AS job_count
FROM turbines t
JOIN work_orders wo ON t.turbine_id = wo.turbine_id
GROUP BY t.turbine_id, t.turbine_tag, t.farm_id
HAVING COUNT(wo.work_order_id) > 1;
SELECT case_number, title, filing_date FROM cases WHERE case_type = 'Civil' AND status = 'Open';

SELECT case_number, title, claim_amount
FROM cases
WHERE claim_amount IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY claim_amount DESC
LIMIT 5;
SELECT full_name, bar_admission_year FROM attorneys WHERE bar_admission_year < 2008 ORDER BY bar_admission_year ASC;
SELECT * FROM hearings WHERE duration_minutes > 100;
SELECT full_name, courtroom FROM judges WHERE specialty IS NULL OR specialty = '';

SELECT case_id, case_number, title, case_type, filing_date, status, judge_id, plaintiff_attorney_id, defense_attorney_id, filing_fee, claim_amount, closed_date
FROM cases
ORDER BY date(REPLACE(filing_date, '/', '-')) DESC
LIMIT 5;

SELECT c.case_number, j.full_name AS presiding_judge
FROM cases c
JOIN judges j ON c.judge_id = j.judge_id
WHERE c.case_type = 'Criminal' AND c.status = 'Open';

SELECT c.case_number, c.title, h.hearing_date
FROM cases c
JOIN hearings h ON c.case_id = h.case_id
WHERE h.hearing_type = 'Arraignment';

SELECT c.case_number, a.full_name AS attorney_name, a.firm_name
FROM cases c
JOIN attorneys a ON c.plaintiff_attorney_id = a.attorney_id
WHERE c.case_type = 'Family';

SELECT c.case_number, c.title, a.full_name
FROM cases c
JOIN attorneys a ON c.defense_attorney_id = a.attorney_id
WHERE a.firm_name = 'Public Defender Office';

SELECT c.case_number, c.title, j.full_name AS judge_name
FROM cases c
JOIN judges j ON c.judge_id = j.judge_id
WHERE c.defense_attorney_id IS NULL;

SELECT c.title, j.full_name, h.hearing_date
FROM hearings h
JOIN cases c ON h.case_id = c.case_id
JOIN judges j ON c.judge_id = j.judge_id
WHERE h.outcome = 'continued';
SELECT case_type, COUNT(*) AS case_count FROM cases GROUP BY case_type;

SELECT hearing_type, AVG(duration_minutes) AS average_duration_minutes
FROM hearings
WHERE duration_minutes IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY hearing_type;

SELECT 
    status,
    COUNT(*) AS case_count,
    SUM(filing_fee) AS total_filing_fees
FROM cases
GROUP BY status;

SELECT strftime('%Y', REPLACE(filing_date, '/', '-')) AS year, COUNT(*) AS case_count
FROM cases
GROUP BY year
ORDER BY year;

SELECT j.judge_id, j.full_name, j.courtroom, COUNT(c.case_id) AS open_case_count
FROM judges j
JOIN cases c ON j.judge_id = c.judge_id
WHERE c.status = 'Open'
GROUP BY j.judge_id, j.full_name, j.courtroom
HAVING COUNT(c.case_id) > 1;

SELECT case_number, title, 
       (julianday(REPLACE(closed_date, '/', '-')) - julianday(REPLACE(filing_date, '/', '-'))) AS days_to_close
FROM cases
WHERE status = 'closed' AND closed_date IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY days_to_close DESC
LIMIT 5;

SELECT c.case_id, c.case_number, c.title
FROM cases c
LEFT JOIN hearings h ON c.case_id = h.case_id
WHERE h.hearing_id IS NULL;

SELECT
    case_id,
    case_number,
    claim_amount,
    CASE
        WHEN claim_amount >= 500000 THEN 'large'
        WHEN claim_amount >= 50000 THEN 'medium'
        ELSE 'small'
    END AS claim_size
FROM cases
WHERE claim_amount IS NOT NULL;
SELECT supplier_name FROM suppliers WHERE city = 'Portland' ORDER BY supplier_name;

SELECT delivery_id, supplier_id, material_id, delivery_date, weight_kg, contamination_pct, truck_plate
FROM deliveries
ORDER BY weight_kg DESC
LIMIT 5;
SELECT material_name, price_per_tonne FROM materials WHERE category = 'Metal' AND price_per_tonne > 1000;
SELECT * FROM processing_batches WHERE status IN ('Rejected', 'In Progress');
SELECT * FROM sales WHERE payment_status IS NULL OR payment_status = '' OR payment_status != 'Paid';

SELECT s.supplier_name, m.material_name
FROM deliveries d
JOIN suppliers s ON d.supplier_id = s.supplier_id
JOIN materials m ON d.material_id = m.material_id
WHERE strftime('%Y-%m', REPLACE(d.delivery_date, '/', '-')) = '2024-03';

SELECT s.supplier_name, m.material_name, SUM(d.weight_kg) AS total_weight_kg
FROM deliveries d
JOIN suppliers s ON d.supplier_id = s.supplier_id
JOIN materials m ON d.material_id = m.material_id
WHERE s.supplier_type = 'Industrial'
GROUP BY s.supplier_name, m.material_name
ORDER BY s.supplier_name, m.material_name;

SELECT DISTINCT m.material_name, m.category
FROM processing_batches pb
JOIN materials m ON pb.material_id = m.material_id
WHERE pb.line_name = 'Line C';

SELECT s.sale_id, s.buyer_name, m.material_name
FROM sales s
JOIN materials m ON s.material_id = m.material_id
WHERE m.category = 'Plastic';

SELECT DISTINCT s.supplier_name
FROM suppliers s
JOIN deliveries d ON s.supplier_id = d.supplier_id
JOIN materials m ON d.material_id = m.material_id
WHERE m.category = 'Glass';

SELECT d.delivery_id, s.supplier_name, d.truck_plate, d.contamination_pct
FROM deliveries d
JOIN suppliers s ON d.supplier_id = s.supplier_id
WHERE d.contamination_pct > 5;

SELECT m.category, SUM(d.weight_kg) AS total_kg
FROM deliveries d
JOIN materials m ON d.material_id = m.material_id
GROUP BY m.category;

SELECT s.supplier_type, COUNT(d.delivery_id) AS delivery_count
FROM suppliers s
JOIN deliveries d ON s.supplier_id = d.supplier_id
GROUP BY s.supplier_type;
SELECT line_name, COUNT(*) AS runs, SUM(input_kg) AS total_input_kg FROM processing_batches GROUP BY line_name;

SELECT buyer_name, SUM(total_revenue) AS total_money
FROM sales
GROUP BY buyer_name
ORDER BY total_money DESC;

WITH supplier_avg AS (
    SELECT
        s.supplier_id,
        s.supplier_name,
        AVG(d.contamination_pct) AS avg_contamination
    FROM suppliers s
    JOIN deliveries d ON s.supplier_id = d.supplier_id
    WHERE d.contamination_pct IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY s.supplier_id, s.supplier_name
),
overall_avg AS (
    SELECT AVG(contamination_pct) AS overall_avg_contamination
    FROM deliveries
    WHERE contamination_pct IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT
    sa.supplier_id,
    sa.supplier_name,
    sa.avg_contamination
FROM supplier_avg sa
CROSS JOIN overall_avg oa
WHERE sa.avg_contamination > oa.overall_avg_contamination;

WITH finished AS (
    SELECT
        batch_id,
        output_kg * 1.0 / input_kg AS recovery_rate
    FROM processing_batches
    WHERE status = 'Completed'
      AND output_kg IS NOT NULL
      AND input_kg > 0
)
SELECT
    batch_id,
    recovery_rate,
    CASE
        WHEN recovery_rate >= 0.93 THEN 'high'
        WHEN recovery_rate >= 0.85 THEN 'medium'
        ELSE 'low'
    END AS recovery_rating
FROM finished;

WITH normalized AS (
    SELECT
        supplier_id,
        date(REPLACE(delivery_date, '/', '-')) AS d
    FROM deliveries
),
bounds AS (
    SELECT
        supplier_id,
        MIN(d) AS first_d,
        MAX(d) AS last_d,
        COUNT(*) AS cnt
    FROM normalized
    GROUP BY supplier_id
    HAVING cnt > 1
)
SELECT
    supplier_id,
    CAST(julianday(last_d) - julianday(first_d) AS INTEGER) AS days_between
FROM bounds;

WITH received_materials AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT m.material_id, m.material_name
    FROM materials m
    JOIN deliveries d ON m.material_id = d.material_id
),
sold_materials AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT material_id
    FROM sales
)
SELECT rm.material_name
FROM received_materials rm
LEFT JOIN sold_materials sm ON rm.material_id = sm.material_id
WHERE sm.material_id IS NULL
ORDER BY rm.material_name;
SELECT title, language FROM shows WHERE genre = 'technology';

SELECT episode_id, show_id, title, episode_number, publish_date, duration_minutes, downloads, guest_name
FROM episodes
ORDER BY downloads DESC
LIMIT 5;

SELECT full_name, hourly_rate
FROM hosts
WHERE country = 'USA'
ORDER BY hourly_rate DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT episode_id, show_id, title, episode_number, publish_date, duration_minutes, downloads, guest_name
FROM episodes
WHERE duration_minutes > 50
  AND (guest_name IS NULL OR TRIM(guest_name) = '');
SELECT sponsor_id, company_name FROM sponsors WHERE contact_email IS NULL OR contact_email = '';

SELECT show_id, title, launch_date
FROM shows
ORDER BY date(REPLACE(launch_date, '/', '-')) ASC
LIMIT 3;

SELECT e.title AS episode_title, s.title AS show_title
FROM episodes e
JOIN shows s ON e.show_id = s.show_id
WHERE s.genre = 'true crime';

SELECT DISTINCT s.company_name
FROM sponsors s
JOIN ad_deals a ON s.sponsor_id = a.sponsor_id
JOIN shows sh ON a.show_id = sh.show_id
WHERE sh.title = 'Tech Tonic';

SELECT h.host_id, h.full_name, h.email, h.country, h.hourly_rate, h.joined_date
FROM hosts h
LEFT JOIN shows s ON h.host_id = s.host_id
WHERE s.show_id IS NULL;

SELECT s.show_id, s.title
FROM shows s
LEFT JOIN episodes e ON s.show_id = e.show_id
WHERE e.episode_id IS NULL;

SELECT e.guest_name, s.title AS show_title, h.full_name AS host_name
FROM episodes e
JOIN shows s ON e.show_id = s.show_id
JOIN hosts h ON s.host_id = h.host_id
WHERE e.guest_name IS NOT NULL
  AND e.guest_name != ''
  AND strftime('%Y-%m', REPLACE(e.publish_date, '/', '-')) IN ('2023-02', '2023-03');

SELECT genre, COUNT(*) AS show_count
FROM shows
GROUP BY genre
ORDER BY show_count DESC;

SELECT s.title, SUM(e.downloads) AS total_downloads
FROM shows s
JOIN episodes e ON s.show_id = e.show_id
GROUP BY s.show_id, s.title
ORDER BY total_downloads DESC;

SELECT language, AVG(duration_minutes) AS average_episode_length
FROM episodes e
JOIN shows s ON e.show_id = s.show_id
WHERE language IS NOT NULL AND language != ''
GROUP BY language;

SELECT s.industry,
       SUM(ad.episodes_booked * ad.price_per_episode) AS total_booked_revenue
FROM ad_deals ad
JOIN sponsors s ON ad.sponsor_id = s.sponsor_id
WHERE ad.status <> 'cancelled'
GROUP BY s.industry;
SELECT * FROM episodes WHERE downloads > (SELECT AVG(downloads) FROM episodes);

SELECT s.company_name, COUNT(d.deal_id) AS deal_count
FROM sponsors s
JOIN ad_deals d ON s.sponsor_id = d.sponsor_id
GROUP BY s.sponsor_id, s.company_name
HAVING COUNT(d.deal_id) > 1;

SELECT
    SUM(CASE WHEN duration_minutes < 30 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS short_episodes,
    SUM(CASE WHEN duration_minutes BETWEEN 30 AND 50 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS medium_episodes,
    SUM(CASE WHEN duration_minutes > 50 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS long_episodes
FROM episodes;

SELECT deal_id, sponsor_id, show_id, start_date, end_date,
       CAST(julianday(REPLACE(end_date, '/', '-')) - julianday(REPLACE(start_date, '/', '-')) AS INTEGER) AS duration_days
FROM ad_deals
WHERE end_date IS NOT NULL AND end_date != ''
ORDER BY duration_days DESC
LIMIT 5;
SELECT title, duration_min FROM movies WHERE rating = 'G';
SELECT title, duration_min FROM movies ORDER BY duration_min DESC LIMIT 5;
SELECT cinema_id, name, city FROM cinemas WHERE manager_name IS NULL OR TRIM(manager_name) = '';
SELECT full_name FROM customers WHERE loyalty_tier IN ('Gold', 'Platinum') ORDER BY full_name ASC;
SELECT ticket_price FROM screenings ORDER BY ticket_price DESC LIMIT 3;

SELECT title, release_date
FROM movies
WHERE date(REPLACE(release_date, '/', '-')) BETWEEN '2024-04-01' AND '2024-06-30'
ORDER BY date(REPLACE(release_date, '/', '-'));

SELECT m.title, c.name
FROM movies m
JOIN screenings s ON m.movie_id = s.movie_id
JOIN cinemas c ON s.cinema_id = c.cinema_id
WHERE date(REPLACE(s.start_time, '/', '-')) >= date('2024-07-01')
GROUP BY m.title, c.name;

SELECT c.full_name, b.tickets_count
FROM bookings b
JOIN screenings s ON b.screening_id = s.screening_id
JOIN movies m ON s.movie_id = m.movie_id
JOIN customers c ON b.customer_id = c.customer_id
WHERE m.title = 'Galaxy Drifters';

SELECT m.title, s.ticket_price
FROM screenings s
JOIN cinemas c ON s.cinema_id = c.cinema_id
JOIN movies m ON s.movie_id = m.movie_id
WHERE c.city = 'Chicago';

SELECT c.full_name, m.title
FROM bookings b
JOIN screenings s ON b.screening_id = s.screening_id
JOIN movies m ON s.movie_id = m.movie_id
JOIN customers c ON b.customer_id = c.customer_id
WHERE b.payment_method = 'mobile app';

SELECT DISTINCT c.name
FROM cinemas c
JOIN screenings s ON c.cinema_id = s.cinema_id
JOIN movies m ON s.movie_id = m.movie_id
WHERE m.genre = 'Sci-Fi';

SELECT 
    b.booking_id,
    COALESCE(c.full_name, 'Guest') AS buyer_name,
    m.title AS film,
    ci.name AS cinema
FROM bookings b
LEFT JOIN customers c ON b.customer_id = c.customer_id
JOIN screenings s ON b.screening_id = s.screening_id
JOIN movies m ON s.movie_id = m.movie_id
JOIN cinemas ci ON s.cinema_id = ci.cinema_id;
SELECT genre, COUNT(*) AS movie_count FROM movies GROUP BY genre;
SELECT payment_method, SUM(total_paid) AS total_money, COUNT(*) AS booking_count FROM bookings GROUP BY payment_method;

SELECT c.city, AVG(s.ticket_price) AS average_ticket_price
FROM screenings s
JOIN cinemas c ON s.cinema_id = c.cinema_id
GROUP BY c.city;

SELECT m.title, SUM(s.seats_sold) AS total_seats_sold
FROM movies m
JOIN screenings s ON m.movie_id = s.movie_id
GROUP BY m.movie_id, m.title
ORDER BY total_seats_sold DESC
LIMIT 5;

SELECT title, imdb_score
FROM movies
WHERE imdb_score IS NOT NULL
  AND imdb_score > (SELECT AVG(imdb_score) FROM movies WHERE imdb_score IS NOT NULL);

SELECT c.customer_id, c.full_name, SUM(b.total_paid) AS total_spent
FROM customers c
JOIN bookings b ON c.customer_id = b.customer_id
GROUP BY c.customer_id, c.full_name
HAVING total_spent > 50;

WITH normalized AS (
    SELECT
        screening_id,
        seats_sold,
        CASE
            WHEN CAST(substr(REPLACE(start_time, '/', '-'), 12, 2) AS INTEGER) < 17 THEN 'daytime'
            ELSE 'evening'
        END AS period
    FROM screenings
)
SELECT
    period,
    COUNT(*) AS number_of_showings,
    SUM(seats_sold) AS total_seats_sold
FROM normalized
GROUP BY period
ORDER BY period;

WITH normalized AS (
    SELECT
        cinema_id,
        name,
        date(REPLACE(opened_date, '/', '-')) AS opened_dt
    FROM cinemas
),
years_open AS (
    SELECT
        cinema_id,
        name,
        (strftime('%Y', '2024-12-31') - strftime('%Y', opened_dt))
        - (strftime('%m-%d', '2024-12-31') < strftime('%m-%d', opened_dt)) AS full_years
    FROM normalized
)
SELECT
    name,
    full_years
FROM years_open
ORDER BY full_years DESC
LIMIT 5;
SELECT name, length_m FROM vessels WHERE length_m > 35 ORDER BY length_m DESC;
SELECT full_name, years_experience FROM captains ORDER BY years_experience DESC LIMIT 5;
SELECT * FROM trips WHERE return_date IS NULL OR TRIM(return_date) = '';
SELECT * FROM trips ORDER BY date(REPLACE(departure_date, '/', '-')) DESC LIMIT 5;

SELECT c.catch_id, c.trip_id, c.species, c.weight_kg, c.price_per_kg, c.grade
FROM catches c
JOIN trips t ON c.trip_id = t.trip_id
WHERE t.return_date IS NOT NULL
  AND (c.grade IS NULL OR TRIM(c.grade) = '');
SELECT * FROM catches ORDER BY price_per_kg DESC LIMIT 3;

SELECT v.name AS boat_name, c.full_name AS captain_name
FROM trips t
JOIN vessels v ON t.vessel_id = v.vessel_id
JOIN captains c ON t.captain_id = c.captain_id
WHERE strftime('%Y-%m', REPLACE(t.departure_date, '/', '-')) BETWEEN '2024-01' AND '2024-03';

SELECT DISTINCT c.species
FROM catches c
JOIN trips t ON c.trip_id = t.trip_id
JOIN vessels v ON t.vessel_id = v.vessel_id
WHERE v.home_port = 'Bergen';

SELECT c.full_name, t.departure_date
FROM captains c
JOIN trips t ON c.captain_id = t.captain_id
JOIN vessels v ON t.vessel_id = v.vessel_id
WHERE v.name = 'Santa Lucia';

SELECT 
    v.name AS vessel_name,
    c.catch_id,
    c.species,
    c.weight_kg,
    c.price_per_kg,
    (c.weight_kg * c.price_per_kg) AS market_value
FROM catches c
JOIN trips t ON c.trip_id = t.trip_id
JOIN vessels v ON t.vessel_id = v.vessel_id
WHERE t.fishing_area = 'Celtic Sea';

SELECT v.vessel_id, v.name
FROM vessels v
LEFT JOIN trips t ON v.vessel_id = t.vessel_id
WHERE t.trip_id IS NULL;

SELECT v.name AS vessel_name, c.full_name AS captain_name
FROM trips t
JOIN vessels v ON t.vessel_id = v.vessel_id
JOIN captains c ON t.captain_id = c.captain_id
WHERE t.return_date IS NULL;
SELECT species, SUM(weight_kg) AS total_kg FROM catches GROUP BY species ORDER BY total_kg DESC;
SELECT vessel_type, COUNT(*) AS count FROM vessels GROUP BY vessel_type;

SELECT species
FROM catches
GROUP BY species
HAVING SUM(weight_kg) > 20000;

SELECT 
    t.trip_id,
    v.name AS vessel_name,
    c.full_name AS captain_name,
    CAST(julianday(t.return_date) - julianday(t.departure_date) AS INTEGER) AS trip_days
FROM trips t
JOIN vessels v ON t.vessel_id = v.vessel_id
JOIN captains c ON t.captain_id = c.captain_id
WHERE t.return_date IS NOT NULL
  AND CAST(julianday(t.return_date) - julianday(t.departure_date) AS INTEGER) > 14;

SELECT
    CASE
        WHEN length_m < 25 THEN 'small'
        WHEN length_m <= 40 THEN 'medium'
        ELSE 'large'
    END AS size_group,
    COUNT(*) AS boat_count
FROM vessels
WHERE length_m IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY size_group
ORDER BY
    CASE size_group
        WHEN 'small' THEN 1
        WHEN 'medium' THEN 2
        ELSE 3
    END;
